name: TV-Chan's Great Escape!
overview: Help TV-Chan sneak out in this NES game!

name: 3 Block Match
overview: A match-3 game for the SEGA Mega Drive / Genesis. Match 3 blocks or more of the same color to earn points as many as possible before the time runs out!

name: Rolling Hare
overview: Rolling Hare is a simple platformer game where you play as a Hare who likes to roll alot. You must collect all carrots in different worlds!

name: Rolling Hare 2
overview: The Rolling Hare is back! You must plow through different levels to collect all carrots!

name: Dino Match
overview: Dino Match is a fast-paced memory and reflex game. Utilizing the exact same core mechanics as Reaction Match, this version trades the modern delivery van for a prehistoric theme, where different shapes or symbols appear one after another on a primitive stone tablet. Players must quickly determine if the current symbol matches the one shown right before it, pressing right for a match or left for a mismatch as they try to rack up as many correct answers as possible before time runs out.

name: Hidden Rule
overview: A reskin of Hidden Agenda.

name: Hide and Seek
overview: Sharing the exact same core mechanics as Table Magic, this version swaps the treasure chests for a prehistoric theme, where players must keep a close eye on a set of dinosaur eggs. After showing which egg hides a baby dinosaur, the game rapidly shuffles them across the screen, challenging the player’s focus and visual tracking skills to successfully pick the right egg.

name: Oviraptor Hazard
overview: Oviraptor Hazard is a memory-based puzzle game. Utilizing the same core gameplay mechanics as Treasure Hunt, this version features a prehistoric setting where players control a Dinosaur on a quest to rescue its lost egg. At the beginning of each stage, the map is briefly uncovered to show the safe paths and the locations of dangerous obstacles or predators; once the layout is hidden, the player must rely on their memory to navigate the treacherous terrain safely and guide the dinosaur back to its egg without hitting any unseen hazards.

name: Reptile Silhouette
overview: Reptile Silhouette is a minimalist, retro puzzle and memory game developed by AtGames and built into many of their classic plug-and-play consoles and handhelds. The gameplay challenges players to quickly match various reptile shapes with their corresponding shadows under a ticking timer.

name: Earthworm Jim
publisher: Gradiente, Playmates Interactive Entertainment, Takara, Virgin Interactive Entertainment (Europe) Ltd.
overview: The Super NES version has altered graphics, with different backgrounds and special effects, but lacked some sound effects and one of the levels from the Genesis version (titled "Intestinal Distress").

name: Earthworm Jim 2
publisher: Playmates Interactive Entertainment, Virgin Interactive Entertainment (Europe) Ltd.
overview: Earthworm Jim 2 was developed for the Sega Genesis and then ported over to the Super NES. They were released virtually simultaneously and were largely the same game, the only differences being that the Super NES version had alternate background art, and the ability to switch weapons.

name: G-LOC: Air Battle
overview: Vigilante forces have raided government military installations and "confiscated" tanks, planes, even warships! Pilot your G-LOC fighter to victory against the guerillas. Only you have the skills to get the job done and save the day!

name: Randy in Sokobanland
overview:
Randy has been trapped in the Net-Cube of Sokobanland.
Beat all 48 levels by collecting the Memory Qdatas in the area by moving the boxes, collecting net-points or getting the power coins to break the cracked bricks.

This game is an spin-off from the upcoming game Randy & Manilla, and it was made in less of one day with Nes Puzzle Maker.

name: Crypto-Fascist
overview: You play as a government agent pushing pills and stack bitcoin in a classic "block pushing puzzle" game.

name: After Burner II
overview: A Sega Genesis port of arcade game "After Burner II". Take to the skies in your F-14 Tomcat for epic dogfights and intense aerial battles. Lock on to your targets and shoot down enemy formations with your machine gun or a barrage of homing missiles.

name: Mantle
overview:
A half-demake, half-fangame reconstruction of a certain part of Deltarune Chapter 3 for the actual NES!

Made over the course of 3 months, this is an NES remake of certain events in Chapter 3 - but with a few twists of its own...

name: Best of the Best: Championship Karate
Roger Clemens' MVP Baseball
overview: Port to SNES and Mega Drive/Genesis.

name: Roger Clemens' MVP Baseball
overview: Port to SNES and Mega Drive/Genesis.

name: Five Nights at Freddy's: NES
overview: Five Nights at Freddy's: NES is a demake of FNAF 1 to the NES, with some slight tweaks made to gameplay in order to spice up the experience. You'll be utilizing your doors, lights, and monitor to ward off any roaming animatronics that try to reach you. Can you survive Five Nights at Freddy's: NES? Good luck.

name: Super Bug Hunters
overview: Blast tons of enemies you encounter along your way in this frenetic run 'n gun with multiplayer support!

name: Duckstroma
overview: Meet Aura, she's a delivery duck and about to have a life changing day on the job. A client has requested 8 disks be delivered to them, but this won't be an easy task. Using Aura's skills navigate the hostile environment by bouncing on weak foes, even lay an egg to reach higher spots.

name: Exodus: Journey to the Promised Land
Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord
overview: NES / Famicom port of the first game in the Wizardry series.

name: Donald in Maui Mallard
overview: When he morphs into a ninja, you better duck! Play as Maui. Play as the Ninja. Play as Maui. Play as the Ninja. Try not to get dizzy. Find the missing Shabuhm Shabuhm idol before your island paradise goes kaboom kaboom! 40 hours of intense gameplay. So pack plenty of attitude. And your bug gun. Come beak to beak with MudDrakes, Rotting Pirates, Duck Zombies, Amazon Warriors. And a bunch of fowl-tempered hangers-on. Laugh in the face of danger from the top of a volcano, the bottom of the sea, the Realm of the Dead, and Ninja Training Grounds. Then get the heck out! Live every level like it's your last - 'cuz it may be!

name: Switchblade
overview:
You must guide Hiro, the Bladeknight through the labyrinth of the
Undercity, to recover the 16 fragments of the shattered Fireblade. Once
you have collected all 16 fragments, you must use it to defeat Havok,
to bring to an end his reign of terror and to avenge your people.

This is a side scroller beat'em up platformer with a bit of metroidvania genre on it!

name: Cadash
overview:
Cadash is an early example of what would become a fairly common trend in Japanese-made arcade games of the early 1990s: the "platform-RPG". Cadash borrows many principles of Zelda II: The Adventure of Link's gameplay, combining side-scrolling platform action with an RPG system of statistics, levels, money and magic.

Four characters can play at once in the arcade version, and up to two players may select from four different characters in the console versions: fighter, mage, priestess, and ninja, each with different attacks, statistics and skills. Players then proceed through each level, killing monsters and bosses, collecting keys to unlock doors and collecting gold and experience. Gold is also taken from slain foes and treasure chests. Villages sell items, weapons, armor and (in the console versions) extra lives, with each village encountered providing better equipment. Some villagers and benevolent creatures will also provide information. The arcade version has a limited game time, which can be extended by buying progressively more expensive hourglasses at shops, or by picking up rare bonuses. In shops, and in hidden places, are medicinal herbs which restore 10 HP if brought to zero, and antidotes which cure poison inflicted by specific foes. There are also two elixirs in the game that act like medicinal herbs, except that they restore all HP.

There are five stages in the game. Stages one, two and four consist of two worlds, above and below ground. Stage three consists of three worlds. Stage five is set entirely within Castle Cadash. The environments differ significantly, from pleasant meadows to caves, and from forests to underwater environments. Some foes encountered in these levels are derived from common mythology while others are completely made up for the game.

The TurboGrafx-16 (PC Engine) version of Cadash, which was translated into English by Working Designs, implemented many changes to the original game, including agility, defense, spell costs and damage, to better balance the characters. Formerly challenging characters such as the fighter and mage were greatly enhanced to rival and even surpass the priestess. To accommodate the differences in hardware power, the levels were divided into large rooms and halls connected by doors and corridors, whereas the arcade game used large, seamless levels. The PC Engine version features colorful, new designs and graphics that are a sharp contrast from the darker shades used in the arcade and Genesis versions. The PC Engine version does not allow any continuing in one-player mode, although dead allies could be revived at inns in two-player mode.

name: Pit-Fighter
overview: Genesis/Mega Drive port of "Pit-Fighter".

name: Ys III: Wanderers from Ys
publisher: Tokyo Shoseki Co., Ltd., Tonkin House
overview:
Adol Christin's long-time friend, Dogi, wishes to return to his home town of Redmont after hearing about strange disturbances that are happening there. Always looking for an adventure, Adol joins him and soon finds out the cause of this new evil.

s: Wanderers from Ys breaks away from the "bumping into enemies" battle system of the first two games, allowing Adol to control his sword in a variety of directions. Beside changing the battle system, the game's perspective switches to a side-scrolling view, as opposed to the top-down one of the previous games. Adol also has the ability to jump now. New to the series is the use of magical rings, which give Adol different powering-up abilities such as healing and shielding. The game also uses various key items found along the way to solve minor puzzles and progress the story.

name: Atomic Runner
overview: Chelnov receives a powersuit from his dying father that he uses to fight the Deathtarians in order to save the Earth and his kidnapped sister.

name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Legend Returns
Xcavator 2025
overview: This is Xcavator 2025 (NES Cartridge), a fully functional NES title built from Oberth’s original design of the same name. First developed at Incredible Technologies Inc., the company behind coin-op classics like Golden Tee Golf, Big Buck Hunter, and more, Xcavator was shopped around to multiple publishers across the country way back in 1991, but it never found a home, and was quietly archived and never looked at again.

name: Block ‘Em Sock ‘Em
overview: Your goal in Block'Em Sock'Em is to control John Hancock through 25 different levels to destroy boxes of the same color. Your aim is to get the block counter below the goal number with a limited number of tosses. If you toss a colored block and it hits another color, then your block will change to that color. There are three difficulty settings.

name: True Galactic Mission
overview: There are 5 pilots in training, each with unique characteristics. It is the day of the final level and everyone wil l face a test to see who will be able to accept the next challenge, a true galactic mission. Be you one of the selecteds!

name: Slaughter
overview: Slaughter is a first person shooter for the Nintendo Entertainment System.

name: Delver Quest
overview:
Whimsical Fantasy: Action Platformer Puzzle

Built for speed-running from the ground up with a built-in game cycle timer.
Unlock items which grant new abilities, opening the possibility for alternate routing!
Collect all of the Crystal Bubble items to discover the bonus quest — a truly “Nintendo hard” experience!
Run, jump, and dive across four exciting worlds with over 150 levels and challenging bosses!

name: Twin Cobra
overview: The NES/Famicom port of Twin Cobra. A helicopter themed shoot 'em up action game from a birds eye view. Developed by Toaplan, it is the successor to their first STG Tiger-Heli, and features similar gameplay.

name: Mai Nurse
overview: Mai Nurse is a tile-matching puzzle video game. The player must help Mai get rid of viruses with pills, lining up 4 slots of the same color horizontally or vertically to destroy them and progress through the levels.

name: Mai Nurse
overview: Mai Nurse is a tile-matching puzzle video game. The player must help Mai get rid of viruses with pills, lining up 4 slots of the same color horizontally or vertically to destroy them and progress through the levels.

name: Mai Nurse
overview: Mai Nurse is a tile-matching puzzle video game. The player must help Mai get rid of viruses with pills, lining up 4 slots of the same color horizontally or vertically to destroy them and progress through the levels.

name: The Trial of Kharzoid
overview: The Trial of Kharzoid is an arkanoidvania for the NES. It combines classic brick-breaking games like Arkanoid with Castlevania's classic elements like exploration, defeating huge bosses and eating chicken you find in walls! The goal is to navigate through the deadly levels and go back to Kharzoid's tower to defeat this son of a witch. You will learn more about the lore by talking to NPCs.

name: Master of Monsters
overview:
The Genesis/Mega Drive port of "Master of Monsters".

Master of Monsters is a turn-based strategy game developed by SystemSoft for the MSX and NEC PC8801. It was ported to a variety of consoles and PCs including the PC Engine CD, NEC PC9801, and Sega Genesis/Mega Drive. While it never had the same success as its SystemSoft stablemate Daisenryaku, the game garnered a loyal following. Its success in the North American market on the Sega Genesis proved sufficient for a sequel on the Sega Saturn, and an anime art-style enhanced Sony PlayStation version.

A European release for Mega Drive was planned by Ubisoft but it did not materialise.

name: The Secret of the Four Winds
overview:
The Secret of the Four Winds is a Japanese-style action role-playing game.

The cartridge contains a custom board with an audio enhancement chip that offers the possibility to enjoy the game with Sega CD / Mega-CD music quality (No actual Sega CD / Mega-CD is required). This game will make use of that audio chip but it can also be played with the console's original audio if desired.

The player will control 3 different characters at the same time (the player can control any of the 3 characters at any time and the other characters will be controlled by the CPU). The player can give orders and priorities to the other characters at any time so the companions do what we need them to do.

The gameplay is deep, with some strategy and tactics, character development at will (grow a given character as a tank or as an attacker or healer, etc.). The story also begins simple and quite typical, but it will evolve and change quite a lot. The decisions you make during the game will have consequences.

The game should take around 20 to 30 hours to finish (depending on the player) and it has re-playability value since your choices will slightly change some parts of the story and ending.

name: Regotown
overview: Discover the Dark Secrets of Regotown

name: Death & Lead
overview: The Sega Mega Drive continues to see support from independent developers well into the 2020s, with Death & Lead being one of the latest titles announced for the platform. Developed by Kai Magazine Software, Death & Lead is a Western-themed, run-and-gun arcade shooter targeting original Mega Drive hardware, with a release window set for late 2025

name: Stormlord
overview:
The Geneis/Mega Drive port of "Stormlord".

Sega of America pulled the Genesis edition of the game off the market and forced Razorsoft to give clothing to cover up the fairies' bare breasts. Indeed, certain advertisements for the game often made note of the controversy. In August 1991 Sega also announced that it was bringing legal action against RazorSoft for unauthorized use of Sega's "trademarks, copyrights and logos," and a breach of contract. However, programmer Kevin Seghetti stated that the changes on the Genesis version were undertaken voluntarily.

name: Echoes of the Unread
overview: Jump and sing to unlock the secrets of the library. Singing will change the world around you and your abilities improve as you explore.

name: Touhou: An Aftermath of the Index
Pokemon II
overview: A strange Pac-Man-type game where Pikachu must collect floating orbs while avoiding mummies, guys with bucket helmets, Arabic caterpillars, Asian butchers, and Grim Reapers, or else he dies and sounds like a Jamaican guy.

name: Virtua Racing
publisher: Sega, Tec Toy Indústria de Brinquedos
overview: The hit arcade racing game is now available on the Genesis with a custom Sega Virtua Processor in the cartridge for enhanced 3D graphics! Switch your camera, view replays, or play split-screen multiplayer.

name: Sack of Flour, Heart of Gold
overview: Sack of Flour, Heart of Gold is a game developed by Bob Rost. This is a game where the player controls a sack of flour moving through 2d levels in order to avoid certain annihilation by the enemies around them.

name: Final Fight MD
overview:
This is a homebrew version of the Final Fight arcade game for the SEGA Mega Drive, created from scratch without using any source code from the original.

As this is a work-in-progress project, please note that it contains numerous bugs, including graphics corruption, lockups, and other unusual behaviors that can occur during gameplay.

name: Filthy Kitchen
overview: Filthy Kitchen is an 8-bit homebrew action-platformer originally developed for the 2016 Nesdev competition. The game is themed around the chore of cleaning a disastrously messy kitchen, with the primary objective being to navigate the environment to locate a missing broom. As players move through the game, they utilize a swatter to crush flies, featuring a combo system that awards massive score multipliers for taking out multiple flies in a single swing. The gameplay also requires players to dodge thematic environmental hazards, such as dirty dishes and out-of-control appliances, while collecting fresh food to restore health and increase their score. The game is available to play directly in a web browser or as a downloadable ROM for NES emulators.

name: Annalog
overview: Annalog is a "Zachtroidvania" homebrew NES game, combining Zach-like programming puzzles with Metroidvania-style platforming, exploration, upgrades, and bosses.

name: Heavy Barrel
overview: Heavy Barrel is a top-down run-and-gun shooter developed by Data East for the Nintendo Entertainment System. Terrorists have seized an underground control complex at a nuclear missile site, and the player must fight through the enemy installation and eliminate its leader. Weapons, grenades, and other power-ups can be found throughout the facility, while keys are used to open locked containers. The ultimate goal is to locate the six pieces of the powerful Heavy Barrel weapon, reassemble it, and use it to defeat the enemy forces. The NES version supports one- or two-player cooperative play.
